'''Frikadeller''' are as [[w:Denmark|Danish]] as the [[w:Dannebrog|Dannebrog]]. This is standard Danish fare, made of ground [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]] and [[Cookbook:Veal|veal]] and traditionally served with [[Cookbook:Boiling|boiled]] [[Cookbook:Potato|potatoes]], [[Cookbook:Gravy|gravy]] and [[Cookbook:Rødkål|rødkål]] ([[Cookbook:Braising|braised]] red [[Cookbook:Cabbage|cabbage]]). Originally, this dish was made so that the meat would feed more people, and thus, the possibilities as to what can be added are numerous.

==Ingredients==
*250 [[Cookbook:Gram|grams]] (about 0.5 [[Cookbook:Pound|lb]]) ground [[Cookbook:Veal|veal]]
*250 grams ground [[Cookbook:Pork|pork]]
*1 large [[Cookbook:Egg|egg]]
*1 [[Cookbook:Onion|onion]], finely [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
*20% by volume (about ¾ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]]) of [[Cookbook:Bread Crumb|bread crumbs]]
*[[Cookbook:Pepper|Pepper]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]] to taste
*[[Cookbook:Mince|Minced]] [[Cookbook:Garlic|garlic]] (optional)
*Ground [[Cookbook:Parsley|parsley]] to taste
*Butter

==Procedure==
#Mix all ingredients except butter together.
#Shape mixture into small patties.
#[[Cookbook:Frying|Fry]] in hot [[Cookbook:Skillet|skillet]] with lots of butter.

== Notes, tips, and variations ==

* These can be frozen and reheated.
* You can substitute bread crumbs with [[Cookbook:Wheat Germ|wheat germ]] and/or [[Cookbook:Oat Bran|oat bran]].
* Any ingredient will work. Many people add a quantity of [[Cookbook:Milk|milk]] also, and the mixture is then thickened again with more flour, bread crumbs and/or oat bran.
